user.description: Choose a ChromaComfort fan to add.

error.device_not_found: That device is not among the discovered fans. Choose one from the list.

abort.no_devices_found: No ChromaComfort fans found. Make sure the fan has power and is in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.already_configured: This fan is already set up.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach {name}. The fan accepts a single Bluetooth connection, so this usually means the ChromaComfort phone app is connected to it right now, or the fan is out of range.

unknown_effect.message: {effect} is not one of this light's effects. Pick a name from the effect list.

init.title: ChromaComfort options
init.description: How often should Home Assistant re-read the fan's state? Each check briefly takes the fan's Bluetooth connection, during which the ChromaComfort phone app cannot control it. Home Assistant reads the state whenever it sends a command regardless, so a long interval is usually fine.
